name: readout-why
cmd: set -e; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1:withheld desk_tempho_1995_s1_late:withheld gp_species_base:trained; do IFS=: read -r cc pop <<< "$c"; mkdir -p {out}/$cc; {python} research/exp/readout_why.py --cache {cache}/$cc --out {out}/$cc --population $pop; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do echo == $d; {python} research/exp/readout_why.py --summarize $d | head -9; done
note: E030: information x scaling x noise decomposition of the readout's change skill (oracle, DESK, regional field)
